title: 第1章 一无所有便不怕威胁第2章 別剥夺圣子之位直接逐出家门吧
slug: 叛出家族后转身投靠魔族女帝
lines: 荒古大陆。
不朽世家，叶家。
巍峨的大殿好似匍匐的荒古巨兽，巍峨雄壮，气镇寰宇。
无垠虚空中，蛰伏的圣级杀阵一座接著一座，守护著整个大殿，击杀一切来犯之敌。
恐怖滔天的圣王威压，更是无时无刻不向外界显露出不朽世家叶家的底蕴与强大。
自三年前叶家率眾击退魔族联军，重伤魔族女帝后，无论是气运还是威望，在荒古大陆都达到了顶点。
如日中天！
而此刻。
大殿之上。
却是另一番景象。
气氛压抑得让人喘不过气来。
“家主，千年火灵芝已经被叶楚尘偷吃了，我亲眼所见！”
大殿之上围满了人，一个身姿婀娜、眉目如画的少女指著叶楚尘，破口大骂：
“千年火灵芝蕴含浓郁的火系灵力，可助小轩突破至辟海境，他叶楚尘竟然敢偷吃了。”
“简直是胆大包天！罪无可恕！”
“百死难辞其咎！！”
饱受指责和谩骂的叶楚尘却好像听不见外界的声音似的，一双深邃如星空般的眼眸此刻满是惊骇与不可思议。
家族会审之际，他这个当事人竟然
走神了。
“叶楚尘，叶灵儿所说的可是真的？那千年火灵芝真的被你偷吃了？”
叶家家主叶鼎看著下方默不作声的儿子，皱了皱眉头，一脸的不悦和不耐烦。
这个逆子也曾是自己的骄傲，只可惜如今
彻底废了。
叶楚尘依旧没有说话，而是下意识用手揉了揉太阳穴，努力地消化著如潮水般涌来的记忆。
他重生了。
叶楚尘是叶家圣子，身怀无上混沌神体，出生时引发地涌金莲、龙凤爭鸣、仙音裊裊，紫气十万里等恐怖异象。
荒古大陆上的修士靠吸纳天地灵气来修炼，修行等级分十境，每一境又有十重天。
分別是：
聚气、凝元、辟海、开天、通灵。
神火、大圣、圣王、准帝、大帝。
而他叶楚尘身怀无上神体，一出生便是聚气境巔峰，三岁入凝元，五岁修成辟海秘境，八岁成开天秘境，十二岁入通灵秘境。
content_en:
The ancient continent.
Immortal family, Ye family.
The majestic main hall is like a creeping ancient beast, majestic and majestic, overwhelming the world.
In the boundless void, dormant holy-level killing formations were lurking one after another, guarding the entire hall and killing all invading enemies.
The terrifying pressure of the Holy King has always revealed to the outside world the heritage and power of the Ye family, an immortal family.
Since the Ye family led the crowd to defeat the demon alliance three years ago and seriously injured the demon empress, both their luck and prestige have reached their peak in the ancient continent.
At the height of the sun!
And at this moment.
Above the main hall.
But it's a different story.
The atmosphere was so oppressive that people couldn't breathe.
"Master, the Millennium Fire Ganoderma lucidum has been secretly eaten by Ye Chuchen. I saw it with my own eyes!"
The main hall was crowded with people. A graceful girl with picturesque features pointed at Ye Chuchen and cursed:
"Thousand-year-old Fire Ganoderma contains rich fire spiritual power, which can help Xiaoxuan break through to the sea-opening realm. He, Ye Chuchen, actually dared to eat it secretly."
"This is simply audacious! The crime is unforgivable!"
"A hundred deaths are inevitable!!"
Ye Chuchen, who had been criticized and abused, seemed to be unable to hear the outside world. His eyes, as deep as the starry sky, were full of horror and disbelief.
During the family trial, his client unexpectedly
Lost my mind.
"Ye Chuchen, is what Ye Ling'er said true? Did you really eat the thousand-year-old fire Ganoderma lucidum?"
Ye Ding, the head of the Ye family, looked at his silent son below and frowned, with a look of displeasure and impatience on his face.
This rebellious son was once his pride, but unfortunately now

Completely useless.
""
Ye Chuchen still didn't speak, but subconsciously rubbed his temples with his hands, trying hard to digest the memories that came flooding in.
He was born again.
Ye Chuchen is the holy son of the Ye family. He possesses the supreme chaotic divine body. When he was born, he caused horrific phenomena such as golden lotuses emerging from the earth, dragons and phoenixes contending, fairy sounds curling up, and purple energy stretching thousands of miles away.
The monks on the ancient continent rely on absorbing the spiritual energy of heaven and earth to practice. The levels of practice are divided into ten realms, and each realm has ten levels of heaven.
They are:
Gather Qi, condense Yuan, open up the sea, open up the sky, and channel spirits.
Divine Fire, Great Sage, Holy King, Quasi-Emperor, Great Emperor.
And he, Ye Chuchen, was pregnant with the Supreme Divine Body. He was at the peak of the Qi Gathering Realm when he was born. He entered the Condensing Yuan at the age of three, cultivated into the Sea Opening Secret Realm at the age of five, entered the Open Heaven Secret Realm at the age of eight, and entered the Spiritual Secret Realm at the age of twelve.
